description: 1. Run `nlm doctor` to verify authentication. 2. Read `references/templates.md` to identify the correct template for a technical/architecture audience — either 'Sharp-edged Minimalism' or 'Neo-Retro Dev'. 3. Run `nlm notebook create` to create a notebook and record the notebook ID. 4. Run `nlm source add <notebook_id> --file docs/microservices_architecture.md` (or --url equivalent). 5. Run `nlm notebook query <notebook_id>` with the FULL verbatim template prompt copied from `references/templates.md` (the proprietary trap: agents must not write their own style text). 6. Run `nlm slides create <notebook_id> --language zh --confirm` (the `--confirm` flag is mandatory and non-obvious) and record the Artifact ID from the output. 7. Run `nlm studio status <notebook_id>` to wait for completion. 8. Run `nlm download slide-deck <notebook_id> --id <artifact_id> --format pptx` using the exact artifact ID from step 6. 9. Copy the resulting `arch_review.pptx` to `~/.openclaw/media/inbound/`. 10. Run `message --filePath ~/.openclaw/media/inbound/arch_review.pptx` with the required message text referencing architecture/slides/Q2.
